name: Block App Updates
compatibility: Targets iOS 15-26 on rootless and native RootHide. ichitaso tested 1.0.5 on iOS 16.5 Dopamine, iOS 17.5.1 Dopamine and iOS 26.0.1 RootHide. sahinkaa tested 1.0.4 on iOS 16.6 RootHide and iOS 26.0.1 RootHide.
description: Block updates for selected App Store apps while preserving your Home Screen layout and notification choices. iOS 15-26.
author: sahinkaa • ichitaso

changes: Preserve the existing Allow or Don't Allow notification choice of all jailbreak, TrollStore and TrollStore Lite apps after the App Store refresh, not only Sileo's.
Trim stray whitespace from helper messages shown in alerts.
Set the helper's setuid bit and the installer scripts' permissions while packaging, so `make package` alone produces a correct package. Remove `normalize_package.py` and simplify `build.sh`.
Automatically save and restore Home Screen folders and icon placement when applying changes. The restored layout persists across later resprings.
Preserve Sileo's existing notification choice after the App Store refresh so it does not ask again.
Shorten the confirmation and show that the device will respring when the refresh is complete.
Show each application's version next to its name in the Settings list, as in 1.0.0's original design.
Fall back to the bundle name when an application's display name is empty, fixing applications listed without a name.

Re-register jailbreak, TrollStore and TrollStore Lite applications after the LaunchServices rebuild, fixing apps that stopped launching, lost their icon labels, disappeared or ran letterboxed after committing changes.
Finish committing as soon as LaunchServices reflects the changed applications instead of always waiting at least 60 seconds (about 15–30 seconds in total on iOS 15-26).
Restart `appstored` together with App Store so blocked and unblocked applications appear correctly in the update list.
Fit application icons to the Settings list rows.
Initial public release.
Selectively blocks and restores App Store updates per application.
Supports staging multiple changes and applying one LaunchServices refresh.
Separates blocked updates from available applications.
Excludes TrollStore-installed applications.
Detects reinstalled applications and clears obsolete blocked metadata.
Supports rootless iOS 15 and later on arm64 and arm64e devices.
Requests Restart SpringBoard after installation, upgrade and removal.

name: CCFlex
compatibility: Requires jailbroken iOS 26. Choose the Rootless or native RootHide build for your jailbreak. iOS 27 support may be possible once a compatible jailbreak is available and CCFlex can be tested.
description:
Customize Control Center on iOS 26
  - Tint glass backgrounds and adjust their opacity.
  - Recolor active fills and set their opacity, or hide supported switch fills.
  - Pick individual colors for supported switch backgrounds and icons.
  - See brightness and volume percentages in compact and expanded sliders.
 .
 Configure in Settings > CCFlex.
author: sahinkaa

changes: Added Increase Contrast for Control Center. With the switch off, Control Center follows the system setting.
Settings previews now update when Increase Contrast is toggled, including solid fills.
Fixed custom icon colors for Amber Switch and other supported switches with image-based icons. Their previews now follow the same fill and background rules as built-in switches.

name: WiFi RSSI Enabler
compatibility: Requires iOS 16 or later. Tested on iPhone 8 Plus (non-notched) with iOS 16.6 and Dopamine RootHide and on iPhone 11 Pro Max (notched) with iOS 26.0.1 and Dopamine 3 RootHide.
description: Show Wi-Fi RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indicator) in the status bar in place of the Wi-Fi bars. The number is in dBm: -50 is stronger than -70. iOS 16 and later.
author: sahinkaa

changes: RSSI now follows the system status bar color, including black text in light apps.
Fixed the RSSI and battery indicators shifting after closing Control Center on iOS 26.
Improved VPN badge spacing in both iOS 16 bars and in iOS 26 Control Center.
iOS 16 Control Center uses a fixed 14-point regular font for RSSI, even when the carrier name is absent.
Fixed an iOS 26 Control Center freeze when toggling Airplane Mode. `Searching` and `No Service` display normally again.
Kept the signed RSSI reading clear of the VPN badge with a fixed width.
Matched the carrier font when visible and used 16-point regular when the carrier label is absent.
